inputs.name: parameterCount.line
inputs.description: Source-code line scanned to estimate a function's parameter count. The helper uses only the first parenthesized substring and counts comma-separated segments, so it is not a syntax-aware parser.

inputs.name: complexityPoints.line
inputs.description: Single source-code line scanned for branch-like tokens. It counts if, for, while, case, catch, and question marks followed by whitespace, except that any line containing the literal return / produces zero; switch is not counted.

inputs.name: maxDepth.lines
inputs.description: Ordered source lines scanned to estimate maximum control-block depth. A line matching if, for, while, switch, or catch before an opening brace increments once, and each closing brace decrements the depth down to zero; this is a brace-counting heuristic.

inputs.name: count.value
inputs.description: String whose occurrences of the supplied token are counted by splitting. Non-empty tokens count non-overlapping separators, while an empty token follows JavaScript split('') behavior.

inputs.name: count.token
inputs.description: String separator used to count occurrences in the value argument. Non-empty separators are counted without overlap; an empty string follows JavaScript split('') behavior and can produce a non-occurrence-style result.

inputs.name: capitalize.value
inputs.description: String whose first UTF-16 code unit is uppercased while the remaining substring is preserved. An empty string stays empty, and the rest of the string is not lowercased.

outputs.name: parameterCount
outputs.description: Estimated count of comma-separated segments in the first parenthesized part of the input line. It returns zero when no parenthesized part is found or that part trims to empty; it does not parse language syntax.

outputs.name: complexityPoints
outputs.description: Count of the matched branch-like tokens in the line, or zero when the line contains return /. Only if, for, while, case, catch, and question marks followed by whitespace are matched; switch is excluded.

outputs.name: maxDepth
outputs.description: Greatest depth reached by the helper's control-block and closing-brace scan. It is zero if no qualifying control-block line occurs and does not represent parser-validated nesting.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Number returned as split(value, token).length minus one. For a non-empty token this counts non-overlapping separators; an empty token uses JavaScript split('') behavior.

outputs.name: capitalize
outputs.description: String returned with its first UTF-16 code unit uppercased and the remaining substring unchanged. Empty input returns an empty string.
